_comment: Function-calling tool specs for the co-authoring LLM. Backed by src/mujoco_skills/service/skill_service.py. The LLM authors a plan (semantic steps, NO coordinates); the backend completes spatial fields and returns schedule + warnings. Vocabulary comes from get_manifest, split into `objects` (enumerable, pickable things), `facilities` (named anchors — capability is whichever of standoff/place/articulation is non-null on that entry, NOT a hand-typed role), `ops` (the parametric navigate/pick/place verbs and their argument constraints), and `skills` (only genuine pre-recorded Open/Close* articulation replays).

function.name: get_manifest
function.description: Return the scene's vocabulary: `objects` (pickable things, each with world_pos and — if one exists — a standoff to approach it), `facilities` (named anchors like island/sink/fridge/counter_left/upper_cabinet/drawer_*, each exposing standoff/place/articulation ONLY if that capability actually exists — e.g. island has standoff=null, so it cannot be navigated to directly), `ops` (navigate/pick/place argument rules), `skills` (Open/Close* replays with precondition/effect), and scene binding. Call this first so plans only reference valid names and respect each facility's actual capability.

function.name: standoff_for_point
function.description: Given a rough target point, return a feasible base standoff pose on the floor facing it (clear of furniture, within arm reach). Use to check/realize a location the user pointed at loosely; if infeasible, propose a different point. Reachability is a 2D planar test.

target_xy.description: World [x,y] the robot should work at.

function.name: compile_plan
function.description: Compile an authoring plan into an executable schedule. Returns per-step start times, cross-robot conflict WARNINGS (shared facility/object/space at overlapping times; placement collisions) which you should resolve by reassigning, reordering, or adding step-level `after` dependencies, and a `completed` plan with backend-filled spatial defaults (standoff/full route/drop point) for inspection. Author only semantic steps — never coordinates; the backend computes geometry.

tasks.description: Semantic tasks. Each is one robot's ordered group of steps.

task.description: Human-readable label, e.g. 'move mug_1 to sink'.

id.description: Optional stable id so other steps can depend on this one.

op.description: One of: navigate, pick, place, reset, wait, or a skill name from get_manifest's `skills` list (e.g. OpenFridge).

target.description: navigate: an object or facility name whose manifest entry has a non-null `standoff`.

grasp_mode.description: pick only: optional grasp approach; defaults to top_down. reachin enters a front-access container empty, grasps the object, then withdraws while carrying it.

grasp_offset.description: pick only: optional [x, y, z] offset from the object center to the grasp point, in metres.

post_grasp_lift.description: horizontal pick only: optional vertical lift in metres after closing and before retreat.

return_to_ready.description: horizontal pick only: return the closed gripper and carried object to the standard ready arm after retreat; defaults to true.

dest.description: place: a facility name whose manifest entry has a non-null `place` (today only 'sink' is actually wired to compile; other destinations will error).

retreat.description: reset only: backward distance in metres; defaults to 0.18.

preserve_yaw.description: reset: true; navigate: 'auto' to translate without turning when final yaw already matches.

after.description: Step ids (any robot) this step must start after — the mechanism for coordination (e.g. robot1 waits for robot0 to finish at a shared facility).
